items.title: NIRDPR Organises Training Programme on Export Marketing for SHG Women at National SARAS Mela, Vijayawada
items.summary: 24 OCT 2026 4:57PM by PIB Vijayawada 24 October 2026 The Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana–National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM), under the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India, promotes the economic empowerment of rural women through Self-Help Groups (SHGs), financial inclusion, and sustainable livelihood opportunities.

facts.text: The National SARAS Mela is one of the Ministry’s flagship market-access initiatives, providing women-led enterprises with opportunities to showcase and sell their products, engage directly with consumers and buyers, understand market preferences, and establish sustainable business linkages.
The National SARAS Mela, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, being held from 13 to 31 October 2026 , marks a significant milestone as the first National SARAS Mela organised outside the Delhi-NCR region.

Key issues included identifying international buyers, reducing dependence on middlemen, maintaining consistent product quality, improving packaging and branding, obtaining relevant registrations and certifications, and addressing export-related documentation, logistics, and financial requirements.

Participants explored various routes to reach buyers, including social media, e-commerce platforms, trade fairs, buyer–seller meetings, merchant exporters, and collective marketing through SHG federations.
